<style>
/* Layout concept: crest header, one sticky strip (Royals | Opponent | Undo | Fix), bright attack pads on calmer cards. Colours come from the crest: deep navy and silver. Light and dark themes both defined. */
:root{
  --ink:#141a3d;
  --bg:#eef1fa;
  --card:#ffffff;
  --line:#d6dcf0;
  --muted:#525c88;
  --soft:#f1f3fb;
  --royal:#20205f;
  --opp:#bd520d;
  --season:#0b7a55;
  --games:#3555d6;
  --silver:#b9bfd0;
  --on-accent:#ffffff;
  --btn-text:#141a3d;
  --shadow:rgba(20,26,61,.25);
  --kill:#2fd47a;
  --err:#ff4d6a;
  --pc:#3bbcf5;
  --amber:#ffc83d;
  --p3:#2fd47a;--p2:#3bbcf5;--p1:#ffc83d;--p0:#ff4d6a;
  --p3t:#e3f5ea;--p2t:#e1f3fb;--p1t:#fdf1d4;--p0t:#fde4e8;
  --miss-bg:#fff0f2;
  --c1:#3b4be0;--c2:#0b9a8a;--c3:#d98200;
  --up:#0b8a4f;--dn:#c93450;
  --display:'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',Arial,sans-serif;
  --body:'Barlow',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;
  color-scheme:light;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    --ink:#eef1ff;--bg:#0c0f2b;--card:#151a44;--line:#2a3070;--muted:#9ea8d6;--soft:#1d2358;
    --royal:#5f5cd6;--opp:#c95d17;--season:#14946a;--games:#4a66f0;--silver:#6b7396;
    --on-accent:#ffffff;--btn-text:#141a3d;--shadow:rgba(0,0,0,.55);
    --p3t:#123a2a;--p2t:#12344a;--p1t:#3f3410;--p0t:#44182a;--miss-bg:#3a1522;
    --c1:#8a94ff;--c2:#3fd0bd;--c3:#ffb43d;--up:#4fe39a;--dn:#ff8aa0;
    color-scheme:dark;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --ink:#eef1ff;--bg:#0c0f2b;--card:#151a44;--line:#2a3070;--muted:#9ea8d6;--soft:#1d2358;
  --royal:#5f5cd6;--opp:#c95d17;--season:#14946a;--games:#4a66f0;--silver:#6b7396;
  --on-accent:#ffffff;--btn-text:#141a3d;--shadow:rgba(0,0,0,.55);
  --p3t:#123a2a;--p2t:#12344a;--p1t:#3f3410;--p0t:#44182a;--miss-bg:#3a1522;
  --c1:#8a94ff;--c2:#3fd0bd;--c3:#ffb43d;--up:#4fe39a;--dn:#ff8aa0;
  color-scheme:dark;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{
  background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--body);font-size:16px;line-height:1.3;
  padding-block:10px 40px;
  padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));
  padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
  touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:var(--bg);z-index:30}
main,.hd,.stick{max-width:640px;margin-inline:auto}
button,input,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:2px}

/* header */
.hd{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;padding-bottom:6px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:3px solid var(--silver)}
.logo{height:76px;width:auto;flex:none}
.bt{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.ov{font-weight:700;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
h1{margin:0;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:36px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase}
.theme{flex:none;border:2px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);border-radius:12px;min-height:44px;padding:0 12px;font-weight:700}
.meta{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.vs{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex:1 1 220px;min-width:0;background:var(--card);border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:4px 10px}
.vs span{font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.vs input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;font-weight:700;font-size:18px;padding:6px 0}
.vs input:focus-visible{outline:0}
#gameDate{background:var(--card);border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:8px 10px;font-weight:600;min-width:0}
.nav2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:8px}

/* tabs and sticky strip */
.stick{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:20;background:var(--bg);padding:6px 0 6px}
.stickrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1.3fr 1fr .8fr;gap:6px}
.lastline{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);padding:6px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.tab{border:3px solid var(--ink);background:var(--card);border-radius:16px;min-height:56px;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:21px;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:0 4px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;min-width:0}
.nav2 .tab{min-height:48px}
.tab.on{color:var(--on-accent)}
.tab.on[data-tab="r"]{background:var(--royal);border-color:var(--royal)}
.tab.on[data-tab="o"]{background:var(--opp);border-color:var(--opp)}
.tab.on[data-tab="s"]{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);color:var(--bg)}
.tab.on[data-tab="z"]{background:var(--season);border-color:var(--season)}
.tab.on[data-tab="g"]{background:var(--games);border-color:var(--games)}
.undo{background:var(--amber);color:var(--btn-text);border:0;border-radius:16px;min-height:56px;box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--shadow);font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:22px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;min-width:0}
.undo:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--shadow)}
.fixbtn{border:3px solid var(--ink);background:var(--card);border-radius:16px;min-height:56px;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:19px;line-height:1.05;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;padding:0 2px;min-width:0}
.fixbtn[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg)}

main{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;padding-top:6px}
.fixbar{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-radius:14px;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:700;text-align:center}

/* scoreboard */
.board{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px 8px;border-radius:20px;padding:14px 10px;color:var(--on-accent)}
@media (min-width:560px){.board{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.board.r{background:var(--royal)}
.board.o{background:var(--opp)}
.board.z{background:var(--season)}
.tile{text-align:center;min-width:0}
.tile span{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.95}
.tile b{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:42px;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

h2.sec{margin:6px 0 0;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:.03em;text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:8px}
h2.sec small{font-family:var(--body);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
.h3{margin:0;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:24px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em}
.note{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}

.card{background:var(--card);border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.ch{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.badge{flex:none;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:30px;color:var(--btn-text)}
.badge.p3{background:var(--p3)}.badge.p2{background:var(--p2)}.badge.p1{background:var(--p1)}.badge.p0{background:var(--p0)}
.cht{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.cht b{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:22px;line-height:1.1;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.02em}
.cht small{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.mt{text-align:right;min-width:82px;flex:none}
.mt span{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.mt b{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:28px;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}

.row3,.row4{display:grid;gap:8px}
.row3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
.row4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}

.btn{appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:18px;min-height:96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;color:var(--btn-text);position:relative;box-shadow:0 5px 0 var(--shadow);transition:transform .06s,box-shadow .06s;padding:6px 2px}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(4px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--shadow)}
.btn .lb{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
.btn .n{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:46px;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.btn.kill{background:var(--kill)}.btn.err{background:var(--err)}.btn.pc{background:var(--pc)}
.btn.pass{background:var(--tint);border:3px solid var(--col);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--shadow)}
.btn.pass .n{font-size:42px}
.btn.p3{--col:var(--p3);--tint:var(--p3t)}.btn.p2{--col:var(--p2);--tint:var(--p2t)}.btn.p1{--col:var(--p1);--tint:var(--p1t)}.btn.p0{--col:var(--p0);--tint:var(--p0t)}
.btn.last{box-shadow:0 5px 0 var(--shadow),0 0 0 4px var(--ink)}
.btn.last:active{box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--shadow),0 0 0 4px var(--ink)}
.btn.flash{animation:pop .25s ease-out}
@keyframes pop{40%{transform:scale(1.07)}}
body.fix .btn.hit{outline:4px dashed var(--ink);outline-offset:-8px}
body.fix .btn.hit::after{content:"\2212 1";position:absolute;top:6px;right:8px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-radius:8px;padding:0 7px;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:16px}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.btn.flash{animation:none}.btn{transition:none}}

/* players */
.plh{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.nm{flex:1;min-width:0;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--soft);font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:.02em;padding:4px 10px;height:48px}
.avg{text-align:right;min-width:60px;flex:none}
.avg span{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--muted)}
.avg b{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:32px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.x{flex:none;min-width:48px;height:48px;border:2px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);border-radius:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);padding:0 8px}
.x.armed{background:var(--err);border-color:var(--err);color:var(--btn-text)}
.add{min-height:64px;border:3px dashed var(--ink);background:transparent;border-radius:18px;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:24px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em}
.empty{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;padding:2px 2px 0}

/* missed serves */
.miss{background:var(--miss-bg);border-color:var(--err)}
.mh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline}
.mh b{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:24px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em}
.mh small{font-weight:700;color:var(--muted)}
.mrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:76px 1fr 2fr;gap:8px;align-items:stretch}
.mn{display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:64px;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.minus{background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border:3px solid var(--ink);min-height:84px;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:40px;box-shadow:none}
.plus{background:var(--err);min-height:84px}
.plus .lb{font-size:16px}
.plus .n{font-size:34px}

/* tables */
.scroll{overflow-x:auto}
.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.tbl th,.tbl td{padding:10px 10px;text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap}
.tbl thead th{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.tbl tbody th{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:20px;text-align:left}
.tbl td{font-weight:600}
.tbl tr.tot th,.tbl tr.tot td{font-weight:800;background:var(--soft);border-bottom:0}
.tag{display:inline-block;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:999px;color:var(--on-accent);font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:22px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;align-self:flex-start;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.tag.r{background:var(--royal)}.tag.o{background:var(--opp)}

/* buttons on sheet */
.sheet{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.act{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;min-height:60px;border:3px solid var(--ink);background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border-radius:16px;font-weight:700;font-size:17px;padding:8px 12px;text-decoration:none}
.act.warn.armed{background:var(--err);color:var(--btn-text);border-color:var(--err)}
.act.go{background:var(--amber);color:var(--btn-text);border-color:var(--amber)}
.act.save{background:var(--kill);color:var(--btn-text);border-color:var(--kill)}
#bkBox{width:100%;min-height:110px;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:10px;font:600 13px/1.4 var(--body);background:var(--soft);color:var(--ink)}

/* season */
.gh{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.gh b{flex:1;min-width:0;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:22px;line-height:1.1;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.02em}
.gh small{display:block;font-family:var(--body);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0}
.gm{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.gm div{background:var(--soft);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 10px}
.gm span{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.gm b{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:28px;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.th{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:8px}
.th b{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:24px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em}
.th .cur{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:34px;letter-spacing:.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.dl{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.dl.up{color:var(--up)}.dl.dn{color:var(--dn)}
.chart{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.chart text{font-family:var(--body)}
.chart .gl{stroke:var(--line);stroke-width:1}
.chart .ax{fill:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:600}
.chart .vl{fill:var(--ink);font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.chart .ln{fill:none;stroke-width:3;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round}
.chart .dot{stroke:var(--card);stroke-width:2}
.s1{stroke:var(--c1)}.s2{stroke:var(--c2)}.s3{stroke:var(--c3)}
.f1{fill:var(--c1)}.f2{fill:var(--c2)}.f3{fill:var(--c3)}

/* total errors, past-game bar, games list */
.errcard{border-color:var(--err);background:var(--miss-bg)}
.errtop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:8px}
.errtop b{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:24px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em}
.errtop .big{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:56px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.errparts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.errparts div{background:var(--card);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 6px;text-align:center}
.errparts span{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.errparts b{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:30px;line-height:1.05;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pastbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--soft);border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:8px 10px}
.pastbar span{flex:1;min-width:0;font-weight:700}
.pastbar .act{min-height:44px;font-size:15px;padding:4px 12px;border-width:2px;flex:none}
.act.open{background:var(--games);color:var(--on-accent);border-color:var(--games)}
.here{display:inline-block;background:var(--games);color:var(--on-accent);border-radius:999px;padding:0 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:8px}
.oppline{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;font-size:14px}

/* both teams on a saved game */
.cmp{table-layout:fixed}
.cmp th:first-child{width:34%}
.cmp th:not(:first-child),.cmp td{text-align:center;padding-left:4px;padding-right:4px}
.cmp thead th{vertical-align:bottom}
.cmp td{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:0}
.cmp tbody th{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:normal;padding-left:4px}
.cmp .tag{display:block;max-width:100%;font-size:18px;padding:2px 6px;text-align:center}
.blk{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;padding-top:12px;border-top:2px solid var(--line)}
.grow{display:flex;gap:8px}
.grow .act{flex:1;min-width:0;min-height:56px}

.fin{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.fin .act{font-size:16px;min-height:58px;padding:6px 8px;line-height:1.15}
.setrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:60px 1fr 18px 1fr 48px;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.setrow b{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:19px;text-transform:uppercase}
.setrow span{text-align:center;font-weight:800;color:var(--muted)}
.sethead{display:grid;grid-template-columns:60px 1fr 18px 1fr 48px;gap:8px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;text-align:center}
.setin{width:100%;min-width:0;height:52px;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--soft);color:var(--ink);font:800 24px var(--body);text-align:center;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.setin::-webkit-outer-spin-button,.setin::-webkit-inner-spin-button{-webkit-appearance:none;margin:0}
.setin{-moz-appearance:textfield;appearance:textfield}
.sets{table-layout:fixed}.sets th:first-child{width:40%}.sets th,.sets td{padding-left:2px;padding-right:2px}.sets tbody th{padding-left:0}
.sets .tag{display:block;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-size:16px;padding:2px 8px}.sets td{font-family:var(--display);font-size:21px}
.tbl td.w{font-weight:800;color:var(--ink)}
.tbl td.l{color:var(--muted)}
#picCv{width:100%;max-width:360px;height:auto;border-radius:12px;align-self:center;background:#0f1229}

/* counters */
function locate(d){
  const p=d.split('|');
  if(p[0]==='atk'){const o=S.t[p[1]].atk[p[2]];return o?{o:o,k:p[3]}:null}
  if(p[0]==='pass'){const pl=S.t[p[1]].players.find(x=>x.id===p[2]);return pl?{o:pl.c,k:+p[3]}:null}
  if(p[0]==='miss')return{o:S,k:p[1]==='o'?'missedO':'missed'};
  return null;
}
function describe(d){
  const p=d.split('|');
  if(p[0]==='atk')return teamName(p[1])+' · Pass '+p[2]+' · '+({k:'Kill',e:'Error',pc:'PC'})[p[3]];
  if(p[0]==='pass'){const pl=S.t[p[1]].players.find(x=>x.id===p[2]);return (pl&&pl.name||'Player')+' · Pass '+PASS[+p[3]]}
  return p[1]==='o'?teamName('o')+' · Missed serve':'Missed serve';
}
function bump(d,delta){
  const L=locate(d);if(!L)return;
  const nv=L.o[L.k]+delta;if(nv<0){toast('Already at 0');return}
  L.o[L.k]=nv;lastD=d;
  S.hist.push({d:d,delta:delta});if(S.hist.length>300)S.hist.shift();
  try{navigator.vibrate&&navigator.vibrate(12)}catch(e){}
  save();render();flash(d);
}
function undo(){
  while(S.hist.length){
    const h=S.hist.pop();const L=locate(h.d);if(!L)continue;
    const nv=L.o[L.k]-h.delta;if(nv<0)continue;
    L.o[L.k]=nv;
    const prev=S.hist[S.hist.length-1];lastD=prev?prev.d:null;
    save();render();toast('Undid: '+describe(h.d));return;
  }
  toast('Nothing to undo');
}
function flash(d){

function lineChart(vals,labels,fmt,k,floor,ceil){
  const W=340,H=170,L=48,R=20,T=26,B=34;

  [lo,(lo+hi)/2,hi].forEach(g=>{s+='<line class="gl" x1="'+L+'" x2="'+(W-R)+'" y1="'+Y(g).toFixed(1)+'" y2="'+Y(g).toFixed(1)+'"/><text class="ax" x="'+(L-6)+'" y="'+(Y(g)+4).toFixed(1)+'" text-anchor="end">'+fmt(g)+'</text>'});

  for(;size>min;size-=2){ctx.font=weight+' '+size+'px '+fam;if(ctx.measureText(t).width<=maxW)return t}
  ctx.font=weight+' '+min+'px '+fam;
  if(ctx.measureText(t).width<=maxW)return t;
  while(t.length>1&&ctx.measureText(t+'…').width>maxW)t=t.slice(0,-1);
  return t+'…';
}
function rrect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);ctx.closePath()}

function recap(g,prev){
  for(let tries=0;tries<8;tries++){const t=recapOnce(g);if(t!==prev)return t}

function recapOnce(g){
  const pick=a=>a[Math.floor(Math.random()*a.length)];

  if(w.n>1&&w.d[0][1]>w.d[0][0]&&win)st.push(pick(['We dropped the first set and came roaring back.','Down a set early, and this group did not quit.']));

    pick(['So proud of this group! 💙','Go Royals! 👑','Love watching this team play! 💜','On to the next one! 🙌']);
  return [hook,story,close].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

function liveGame(id){return id===S.gid?snapshot():S.games.find(x=>x.id===id)}
function liveBody(g){return JSON.stringify({app:'royals',status:'final',p:packGame(g)})}
function hashStr(t){let h=5381;for(let i=0;i<t.length;i++)h=((h<<5)+h+t.charCodeAt(i))|0;return t.length+':'+(h>>>0).toString(36)}
function liveMark(){

function liveKick(delay){

}
function livePending(){

async function livePump(){

          const r=await fetch(LIVE_API+L.code,{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Write-Key':L.key},body:'{"rev":'+rev+',"data":'+data+'}'});

          else if(r.status===429){L.dirty=true;LQ.msg='rate';toast('Too many new links from this network right now. It will keep trying.')}
          else if(r.status===404||r.status===405){L.off=true;LQ.msg='nosite';ok=true}
          else{L.dirty=true;LQ.msg='retry'}

    if(curId&&S.links[curId])S.links[curId].dirty=true;
    LQ.msg=navigator.onLine===false?'offline':'retry';
  }

async function livePoll(){

    if(r.ok){

        g.live=true;VIEW=g;LIVE.rev=j.rev;LIVE.chg=Date.now();render();
